statement:
I'll look up the gradebook column record for GC-441 first.
The record shows the marking file has scores out of 10, but the column's points possible is 100. Since the scores in the marking file are on a 10-point scale, I'll post the grades against 10 points possible to ensure the grades are accurately represented (e.g., a 7 stays as 7/10 = 70%, rather than being misread as 7/100 = 7%).
judge_text:
WRONG
It states "the column's points possible is 100" conflicts with the 10-point scores, giving the correct value ("post the grades against 10 points possible") and naming the 7/100 = 7% error.
[judge: anthropic/claude-opus-5]
